info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server - Remote Command Execution
author: dwisiswant0
info.description: The Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware (subcomponent: Web Services) allows unauthenticated attackers with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server. Versions that are affected are 10.3.6.0.0 and 12.1.3.0.0.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can compromise Oracle WebLogic Server via the Web Services component, potentially leading to complete server takeover and unauthorized access to sensitive data.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Oracle to fix the vulnerability and ensure proper input validation and sanitization of XML data.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server - Remote Command Execution
author: dr_set
imnightmaree
true13
info.description: The Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware (subcomponent - WLS Security) is susceptible to remote command execution. Supported versions that are affected are 10.3.6.0.0, 12.1.3.0.0, 12.2.1.1.0 and 12.2.1.2.0. This easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers with network access via T3 to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the WebLogic server.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Oracle to fix this vulnerability. Additionally, restrict network access to the WebLogic server and implement strong authentication mechanisms.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server Console JNDI Injection - Chained Pre-Auth RCE (HTTP OAST)
author: tr1la
info.description:
CVE-2021-2109 is a JNDI injection in the WebLogic Administration Console's
JndiBindingHandle that leads to remote code execution. The injection point is
in the consolejndi.portal JNDI binding page: the JndiBindingHandle constructor
splits its argument on semicolons and rejoins the components with dots to form
a JNDI name, which is passed to InitialContext.lookup() without sanitization.

Although the vulnerable endpoint requires administrator authentication, this
template chains it with CVE-2020-14882's double-encoded path traversal auth
bypass (/console/css/%252e%252e%252f) to achieve unauthenticated exploitation.
The css/ prefix is required — images/ causes a 302 redirect that prevents
the JNDI portlet from rendering and the lookup from firing.

OAST confirmation: the template injects an LDAP URL pointing to the interactsh
hostname. JndiBindingHandle splits on semicolons and rejoins with dots, so the
hostname is reconstructed correctly. The server-side JNDI lookup DNS-resolves
the hostname, producing a DNS callback captured by interactsh.

Affected: 10.3.6.0.0, 12.1.3.0.0, 12.2.1.3.0, 12.2.1.4.0, 14.1.1.0.0.
Requires CVE-2020-14882 auth bypass to also be unpatched (pre-October 2020 CPU).
Lab-verified on both 12.2.1.4 and 14.1.1.
info.remediation:
Apply the Oracle January 2021 CPU (or later), restrict access to /console, and
enforce strong administrator credentials.
